scope: Prerequisite review of five CaliLuke skills originals, not execution evaluation
linked_reference_caveat: All five original bodies were read with addresses redacted. Linked references and scripts were not read or executed. Missing packages, adapters, fixtures, service access and human evidence are prerequisite gaps, not permanent exclusions or observed failures.

sources.workflow: Design, implement and rerun software tests through public interfaces, using explicit assertions, representative variants and faithful test doubles.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual software under test, its public contract, executable project and test runner, dependencies and suitable input fixtures. Mocked interfaces require accurate signatures and behavior; changing production code requires rerunning relevant tests.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated local software project can support faithful test development and execution. This is ordinary software testing, not by itself a model benchmark. Fake I/O cannot establish real external-service behavior, and a test plan or fixed expected output does not establish an executed test suite.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Execute submitted tests against the actual original implementation and declared behavior-changing variants, reconcile assertions and test results, and check fake implementations against their real contracts. Mutation fixtures would require separate review and freezing before inference.

sources.workflow: Integrate browser-based music notation rendering and playback, configure assets and styles, manage readiness and player events, select tracks and construct notation input.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A JavaScript or TypeScript application, compatible packages and official Vite integration where applicable, worker support, fonts and soundfont assets, notation or score data, and a browser with the required DOM, rendering and audio capabilities.
sources.offline_assessment: A reviewed project with complete local packages, assets and a browser/audio harness could support offline rendering and playback. The current Python-only and symbolic runtimes do not provide these prerequisites. Static configuration and simulated player events cannot establish an actually rendered score or audible playback.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Build the real application, inspect browser errors and actual score rendering, verify lifecycle and track interactions, and check real audio output or an appropriately specified audio artifact before claiming playback.

sources.workflow: Plan and integrate Better Auth server and client configuration, routes, database schemas and migrations, credential and email flows, session checks, two-factor authentication and organization permissions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual JavaScript or TypeScript app with known framework, router, package manager, database and adapter; compatible library and migration tooling; configured secrets and origins; selected sign-in methods and matching server/client plugins. OAuth, email, messaging and production deployment need their separately configured services and authorization.
sources.offline_assessment: A fully provisioned isolated application and local database can support selected local authentication and authorization flows. Production OAuth, actual email or SMS delivery, real deployment and operational security are not proved by generated configuration or fake callbacks. The original contains both dedicated plugin-import guidance and barrel-import examples, so compatibility must be established against the selected package version rather than assumed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Run migrations and the actual server; exercise registration, login, protected routes, session behavior, verification/reset and any selected second-factor or role boundaries. Confirm issued cookies, database state, token reuse and access denials independently. Live delivery or production claims require actual separately authorized evidence.

sources.workflow: Configure authentication secrets, rate limits, origin and CSRF checks, sessions and cookies, OAuth-token storage, trusted proxy handling, audit hooks and background tasks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual compatible Better Auth application and database or secondary storage, runtime secret configuration, declared origins and deployment/proxy topology, representative auth requests, and any selected OAuth, audit-log or background-task infrastructure.
sources.offline_assessment: Selected authentication controls can be configured and exercised in a fully provisioned local fixture with disposable data and no outside connections. Static settings are not proof that controls operate, and simulated identity providers or proxy headers do not establish production identity, deployment or infrastructure trust.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Use bounded sandbox requests and controlled time/state to check rate-limit enforcement and persistence, rejection of untrusted requests, session expiration and cookie attributes, selected stored-token protections, and actual audit/background-task behavior. Verify proxy assumptions against the specified local topology; do not test live accounts or services.

sources.workflow: Curate component-library sections and story-card presentation independently, derive configuration from declared component tags, preserve handwritten skips, exchange feedback as files and verify emitted artifacts and moved paths.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real component/story repository and its build and quality gates; design-sync configuration, provider and project identity; the shared project filesystem and read/write transport; actual card outputs and the detailed linked references that override the summary when they disagree.
sources.offline_assessment: Local tag/config generation, preservation checks and some build or rendering checks could be faithful with the complete project and harness. The actual shared-filesystem exchange, remote upload/deletion and final project state require the corresponding adapter. Passing static checks does not prove a usable responsive card or absence of clipped content.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect generated configuration and real emitted/rendered cards across specified modes and viewports; verify preserved skips and reference-defined contracts. Reconcile project file listings and artifact contents before and after moves or feedback consumption, preserving templates; actual upload claims need actual authorized transport evidence.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
